description: This file implements functions for managing an object ID map, including initialization, insertion, retrieval, removal, and clearing of entries, utilizing a hashmap data structure.

methods.name: int oidmap_neq(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * e1,const struct hashmap_entry * e2,const void * keydata)
methods.description: Comparison function for oidmap entries, used to determine inequality based on object IDs.

methods.name: void oidmap_init(struct oidmap * map,size_t initial_size)
methods.description: Initializes an oidmap with a specified initial size.

methods.name: void oidmap_clear(struct oidmap * map,int free_entries)
methods.description: Clears all entries in an oidmap, with option to free entries.

methods.name: void * oidmap_get(const struct oidmap * map,const struct object_id * key)
methods.description: Retrieves an entry from the oidmap based on a key object ID.

methods.name: void * oidmap_remove(struct oidmap * map,const struct object_id * key)
methods.description: Removes an entry corresponding to a key object ID from the oidmap.

methods.name: void * oidmap_put(struct oidmap * map,void * entry)
methods.description: Adds an entry to the oidmap.

ctags.name: oidmap_get
ctags.signature: (const struct oidmap * map,const struct object_id * key)

ctags.name: oidmap_neq
ctags.signature: (const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * e1,const struct hashmap_entry * e2,const void * keydata)
